description: On the desk in front of you are two red-capped markers, a few small rubber duck toys, and an open cardboard box near the back. The left hand slides the two markers together toward the center, while the right hand picks up the small toys one by one from the right side and sets them beside the markers, then both hands lift the toys and toss them into the open box; finally the left hand gathers the two markers and raises them toward the box to throw as well.
